description: This Java class provides methods to generate selection criteria for MongoDB operations related to event sourcing persistence, specifically for selecting/deleting documents based on entity IDs and namespaces within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: MongoPersistenceOperationsSelectionProvider
classes.description: An immutable provider class that offers methods to create MongoPersistenceOperationsSelection objects for selecting or deleting documents in MongoDB event source persistence based on entity IDs or namespaces.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of MongoPersistenceOperationsSelectionProvider with specified settings.

methods.name: selectEntity
methods.description: Produces a collection of selection objects targeting all records related to the given EntityId across different MongoDB collections (metadata, journal, snapshot).

methods.name: selectNamespace
methods.description: Produces a collection of selection objects targeting all records within a given namespace, if namespaces are supported.

methods.name: selectNamespaceByPid
methods.description: Helper method to create a selection for a specific collection based on namespace prefix filtering.

methods.name: filterByPidPrefix
methods.description: Creates a BSON regex document to match process IDs with a specific namespace prefix.

methods.name: selectEntityByPid
methods.description: Helper method to create a selection for a collection based on an EntityId.

methods.name: filterByPid
methods.description: Creates a BSON string document to match process IDs associated with an EntityId.
